{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u023/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f8b0213a.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Locate uniform separator rows/columns by their value and segment the matrix.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = grid[0][0]  # ordinary background
    # The separator is the color that forms complete internal rows/columns.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != sep]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and
                len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != sep]
    # Background is the most frequent color; separators are full lines of another color.
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]) and grid[r][0] != background]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and grid[0][c] != background]
    # Treat full separator lines as dividers and count non-background/non-divider objects per cell.
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1])
                     for c in range(col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1])]
            counts = Counter(cells)
            counts.pop(background, None)
            # Dividers are absent from the interior, so the repeated-object count is decisive.
            row.append(1 if sum(counts.values()) == 2 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
"
}
